expected.description: On a pull request with no review yet the merge fixer skips review-cycle.sh fix, so no fork or collaborator check runs before it builds, tests and regenerates lockfiles on the pull request's code.
harness-loop.md runs step 0 only on entry, so a base that moves into a conflict after a BLOCKED verdict never reaches the merge fixer and passes on an unchanged head use up the cycle budget.

Step 0 of harness-loop.md gives the merge fixer no hidden-content scan results, and the merge fixer never runs scan-hidden.py, although pull request text and commit messages steer each conflict resolution.
No update test asserts that pr-merge-fixer is updated, or that an install without it does not gain it.
